title: Concept: Gemfile.lock with no PLATFORMS section
description: Gemfile.lock declares a lockfile that records no target platforms, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a lockfile that records no target platforms.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile.lock (rubygems).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a lockfile that records no target platforms.
